title: Exclusive Interview with CLO Founder Jaden: Unveiling the Stories Behind CLO and MD, Essential Knowledge for Fashion Designers!
description:
Jaden Oh, the founder of CLO Virtual Fashion, appeared on "The Globalist" to unveil the technological power behind movie character costumes! Designers use CLO and Marvelous Designer software to transform creativity into dazzling new stars in fashion, film, and gaming, achieving unprecedented efficiency and eco-friendly concepts, allowing creativity to flourish freely in the digital world. Another software under CLO, Jinny, makes design dreams accessible, breaking down professional barriers so that ordinary people who aspire to design, but have never ventured into it, can easily sketch their envisioned garments.

CLO Virtual Fashion's vision is gradually being realized through the integrated platform CLO-SET, which combines design asset aggregation, information sharing, and metaverse marketing, painting a new blueprint for the future of the fashion industry!

summary: ```markdown # Exclusive Interview with CLO Founder Jaden: Unveiling the Stories Behind CLO and MD, Essential Knowledge for Fashion Designers! ## Introduction Welcome to the world of virtual fashion! Today, we will be discussing groundbreaking advancements in garment creation technology. Our guest is Jaden Oh, the founder of CLO Virtual Fashion, who has developed a tool that allows all garments to be virtualized and accessible for fashion designers and enthusiasts alike. ## Meet Jaden Oh Let's meet Oh Seung Woo, or Jaden Oh, the founder of CLO Virtual Fashion. Welcome, Jaden, to the show! > Thank you for this great introduction. Well, I mean, you deserve it. ## Achievements and Awards ### Scientific Engineering Award Congratulations are in order, I hear. In February, you received the Scientific Engineering Award from the U.S. Academy of Motion Pictures. This is the same place that hands out the Oscars. So, you have an Oscar! > Yes, I got an Oscar in February. ### About the Award What was the award about? The Oscars are well-known for awarding actors and directors, but they also have another category for technical and scientific contributions to the film industry. > Yes, it's called the Sci-Tech Award. It recognizes contributions to the filmmaking industry. ## Contribution to Filmmaking What contribution did you make? > We have made significant contributions, especially to the garment-making process in the film industry. There are lots of costumes needed to create great movies and animations. We offer software that allows designers to create 3D garments to help visualize what characters should wear. ### The Problem with Traditional Tools Before our tool was adopted in this field, most tools were based on sculpting, where garments were created piece by piece. This sculpting process is very time-consuming and requires expertise from modelers. Our tool, however, is based on computer simulation, accurately mimicking the real-life garment-making process. ## Applications in Film ### Recent Film Collaborations Let's apply it to a recent movie that your software was used on. > Our software was used in "Black Panther," "Avatar," and "Guardians of the Galaxy." In these films, computer-generated scenes often require digital costumes, especially for dangerous or fantastical storytelling. ### Pre-Visualization The main designer for "Black Panther" used our tool to create 3D versions of garments before starting the actual filming. This pre-visualization allows filmmakers to see the costumes on characters before production begins. ## Marvelous Designer ### What Makes It Unique The software is called Marvelous Designer. What makes it stand out? > Before Marvelous Designer, there were many tools for garment design, but they were primarily sculpting-based. Our software simulates garment making using advanced simulation technology, allowing for much faster and more accurate results. ### Industry Adoption Almost 100% of films that use computer graphics for characters likely utilize Marvelous Designer for clothing. It's a significant market. ## Usage in Fashion Industry ### Fashion Brands I understand filmmaking is just part of your business. How do major fashion brands like H&M and Louis Vuitton utilize your software? > In the fashion industry, our software is used similarly to how it is used in computer graphics. Brands create 3D samples instead of physical ones, which reduces fabric waste and promotes sustainability. ### High-Quality 3D Samples Top fashion brands require high-quality 3D samples. Our software allows them to create these samples without the need for multiple physical iterations. ## Challenges and Improvements ### Realism in Simulation It was initially tough to achieve the level of realism required in our software, but over the past decade, we have made significant improvements. We now have over 800 features to visualize and refine 3D draping and modeling in real time. ### Empowering Designers Fashion designers can create top-of-the-line garments using our software, which simulates the real garment-making process. ## Community Engagement ### Early Users When you started 16 years ago, your base was normal designers and fashion students. Can you tell us about your first users? > Our first users were part of a community interested in virtual cosplay. They enjoyed dressing up digital characters in beautiful costumes and shared their creations online, helping us gain international recognition. ## Transition to Filmmaking ### Recognition from Major Studios This community eventually spread to other areas such as game-making and filmmaking. One of our first users was from Weta Digital, the studio behind "Avatar" and "The Lord of the Rings." After our launch, they reached out to purchase our software. ## Sustainability in Fashion ### Positive Environmental Impact The use of our software promotes sustainability in the fashion industry. By creating 3D samples instead of physical ones, we significantly reduce fabric consumption and waste. ### Carbon Emission Reduction Fashion brands are now using our software for virtual fashion shows and showrooms, further contributing to carbon emission reduction. ## Future of CLO Virtual Fashion ### Upcoming Software: Genie You have another software package coming out called Genie, designed for non-professionals. > Yes, Genie allows users without extensive knowledge of pattern making to create garments easily. ### Accessibility for All Can someone like me, who has never used a sewing machine, actually make real clothes using Genie? > Yes! If you can create it in 3D, it can be produced in real life. Genie is designed to simplify the process. ## Personal Motivation ### A Message for Your Kids In your acceptance speech for the awards, you mentioned wanting to be someone your kids would be proud of. What motivated that statement? > My kids, being teenagers, don't care much about awards. But I once helped my son create a garment for his grandfather, which highlighted the importance of making garment creation accessible. ## Looking Forward ### Future Innovations Where do you see CLO going in the future? > We envision a platform where our software can create lots of 3D content, with valuable data that can be accessed by fashion designers worldwide. This could revolutionize the entire fashion-making process. ## Conclusion Thank you for sharing your insights, Jaden. It's clear that CLO Virtual Fashion is poised to take the industry into a new era of innovation and sustainability. ```
